items.quote: You'll need API keys, which you can receive by signing up in the Dashboard.
items.why: Shows API keys issued via Dashboard signup; says nothing about header/body methods or other auth.

items.quote: Our Free Trial allows you to make API calls using live data.
items.why: Says Free Trial makes live-data calls; no mention of self-serve gating or US/Canada limits.
Says Sandbox is free; does not cover the live-credential gate or Pay as You Go.

items.quote: Month to month with no commitment. No caps on usage. Only pay for what you use.
items.why: Month-to-month, no commitment, pay-per-use; no $0/month or Dashboard-keys statement.

items.quote: The Plaid API is JSON over HTTP.
items.why: Confirms JSON over HTTP (REST-like); says nothing about breadth or product count.

items.quote: The **Dashboard MCP server** is a remote MCP server hosted by Plaid.
items.why: States the Dashboard MCP server is a remote server hosted by Plaid, i.e. exists and is vendor-official.

items.quote: Your team must be approved for Production access with at least one Plaid product to use the MCP server.
items.why: Implies the MCP server is usable with Production approval; does not directly state it exists or is official.
